en.title: When More Structure Hurts: Four Skin Reaction Trace Failures
en.description: An English trace casebook showing how identity-visible reasoning turned plausible structural hypotheses into false-positive Skin Reaction labels.

zh.title: 结构信息何时适得其反：四个皮肤反应推理失败案例
zh.description: 一个中英文双语推理案例集，展示 identity-visible 模型如何把合理但未经验证的结构假设升级为皮肤反应假阳性。
